quest.mod.madera_invierno.title: Wood for the Winter
quest.mod.madera_invierno.description: I need 10 oak logs before the cold arrives. Can you help me?
quest.mod.suministros_medicos.title: Medical Supplies
quest.mod.suministros_medicos.descriptio: I need 5 poppies to prepare medicine. Bring them to me when you have them.
quest.mod.minerales_escasos.title: Scarce Minerals
quest.mod.minerales_escasos.description: The village blacksmiths need iron. Get me 3 ingots and I will reward you well.
quest.mod.provisiones_granja.title: Farm Supplies
quest.mod.provisiones_granja.description: The harvest was poor this season. I need 8 carrots to feed the village through winter.
quest.mod.madera_oscura.title: Dark Timber
quest.mod.madera_oscura.description: The village walls need reinforcing. Bring me 10 dark oak logs and I will make it worth your while.
quest.mod.lana_para_camas.title: Wool for Beds
quest.mod.lana_para_camas.description: Several families lost their beds in the last raid. I need 6 wool to make new ones.
quest.mod.pan_para_el_pueblo.title: Bread for the Village
quest.mod.pan_para_el_pueblo.description: The village is hungry. Bring me 10 loaves of bread and I will reward you well.
quest.mod.carbon_para_el_invierno.title: Coal for Winter
quest.mod.carbon_para_el_invierno.descri: We will freeze without fuel. I need 16 pieces of coal before the first snow falls.
quest.mod.cuero_para_el_sastre.title: Leather for the Tailor
quest.mod.cuero_para_el_sastre.descripti: I need leather to repair the guards' armor. Bring me 5 hides and come back to collect your reward.
quest.mod.tinta_para_el_bibliotecario.de: My quill has run dry and there is much left to write. Bring me 4 ink sacs from the sea.
quest.mod.reparacion_herramientas.title: Tool Repairs
quest.mod.reparacion_herramientas.descri: The village tools are falling apart. I need 6 iron ingots to fix them. Come back when you have them.
quest.mod.perlas_del_comerciante.title: Merchant's Pearls
quest.mod.perlas_del_comerciante.descrip: A wandering merchant passed through and left me in debt. I need 3 ender pearls to settle it. Return to me once you have them.
quest.mod.oro_para_el_joyero.title: Gold for the Jeweler
quest.mod.oro_para_el_joyero.description: I am crafting a gift for the village elder. Bring me 4 gold ingots and return so I can reward you properly.
quest.mod.diamante_para_el_herrero.title: Diamond for the Blacksmith
quest.mod.diamante_para_el_herrero.descr: I have dreamed of forging diamond tools for this village my whole life. Bring me 2 diamonds and come back. I will not forget it.
quest.mod.manzana_dorada.title: The Golden Apple
quest.mod.manzana_dorada.description: Our elder is gravely ill and nothing I have tried has worked. I have heard a golden apple can cure any ailment. Please, bring one and return quickly.

quest.mod.map.title: World Map
quest.mod.toast.title: Mission accepted!
quest.mod.toast.subtitle: Collect resources
